findingDetails.title: The automatic nudge names a note path in a directory it never creates
findingDetails.evidence: plannedNotePath builds the handoff note path but never creates the handoffs directory; only /speckit:handoff does.
findingDetails.recommendation: Create the handoffs directory with mode 0700 in plannedNotePath and add a clean-state test.
findingDetails.scopeProof: All five automatic adapters route through plannedNotePath; no mkdir exists in nudge or the adapters.

findingDetails.title: A second handoff can orphan the first open note and a later nudge can reuse the stale path
findingDetails.evidence: prepare overwrites the loop record and supersedeClaimed only closes claimed notes, while openNotePathFor returns the first open note in directory order.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reuse or supersede the session's open note before a new record, and prefer the newest open note; add a two-invocation test.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The two planners disagree and no test covers two open notes for one session.

findingDetails.title: Handoff notes inherit the default permissive directory and file modes
findingDetails.evidence: The handoffs directory is only joined, not created with a private mode, and writeHandoffUpdate preserves the note's existing mode.
findingDetails.recommendation: Create the handoffs directory 0700, pin notes 0600, stop preserving a permissive mode, and assert the modes in tests.
findingDetails.scopeProof: All handoff writers use the same directory and the same preserved mode; no note mode pin exists.

findingDetails.title: Phase 007 cites a live-run log that is absent and permanently ignored by Git
findingDetails.evidence: AC-006 to AC-008 cite relaunch-run10.log by line; the evidence directory has only launch-commands and pane captures; git check-ignore reports .gitignore:263 *.log.
findingDetails.recommendation: Store the log under a non-ignored name or add a targeted negation, update every citation and hash, or amend the AC to cite the tracked panes and outcome JSON.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The three AC rows and the benchmark rows name the missing path; git check-ignore proves the named path is excluded.

claimAdjudication.claim: Phase 007's acceptance criteria and benchmark report cite a live-run log that is absent from the repository and excluded by the .gitignore *.log rule.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Searched the evidence and benchmark directories, the whole repository, and sibling worktrees for the filename; checked git ls-files and git check-ignore; read the benchmark outcome JSON, which repeats the path and hash without embedding the bytes.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: The log may be intentionally local-only because the repository ignores *.log; rejected because the AC marks the log citations Met and the benchmark declares requireDurableEvidence true.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: If the AC and benchmark are amended to cite the tracked panes and outcome JSON as the durable record and the log claim is removed, downgrade to P2.

findingDetails.title: The parent specification still counts six children and leaves the 006-to-007 handoff row undefined
findingDetails.evidence: The metadata and purpose say six, In Scope and Files to Change stop at 006, and the final handoff row is TBD while the phase map lists 007 complete.
findingDetails.recommendation: Say seven, add phase 007 to In Scope and Files to Change, and fill the 006-to-007 handoff row.
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg over the file shows the seven-row phase map and the six-child prose in the same document.

findingDetails.title: Phase 006's review evidence cites an absent report path and an ephemeral temp table
findingDetails.evidence: The scope and dependency cite ../review/review-report.md and an absolute /private/tmp table; the report is absent from review/ and exists only in review-archive/20261019T144809Z; AC-010 and AC-011 repeat the stale path.
findingDetails.recommendation: Repoint to the archived report, copy the verification table into the packet or cite the archived section, and update AC-010 and AC-011.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The review tree has no review-report.md; the archived report exists and the stale citations are listed by rg.

findingDetails.title: The handoff command documents exit 3 as outside-loop only, while the CLI also returns 3 at the hop cap
findingDetails.evidence: The CLI table and Step 5 say exit 3 means outside skilled-loop; prepare returns 3 inside the loop at the hop cap after printing the decline and manual command.
findingDetails.recommendation: Describe exit 3 as outside-loop or at the hop cap, distinguish the lines and log reasons, and add a command-doc example.
findingDetails.scopeProof: session-relaunch.cjs has two return-3 paths; the command document describes only the outside-loop path.

results.summary: Parent count/scope drift and the handoff exit-code drift; the seven-phase map itself is current.
Most rows resolve; AC-006/007/008 cite an absent log and AC-010/011 cite an absent report path.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: The packet spans seven child phases and multiple review generations; the traceability target is the closure contract and its evidence.

omittedHighRiskTargets: adapter payload parity; scheduled for the broadened pass
maintainability of the killer; scheduled for iteration 4
